claims.text: The Lowell is at 28 East 63rd Street on Manhattan's Upper East Side.

findings.quote: The Lowell is located at 28 East 63rd Street, New York; in the heart of Manhattan's prestigious Upper East Side.

claims.text: The hotel sits on a quiet, tree-lined residential street between Madison Avenue and Park Avenue.

findings.quote: Situated on a quiet, tree-lined residential street between Madison Avenue and Park Avenue

claims.text: Guests are steps from Madison Avenue's luxury boutiques and a 5 minute walk from Central Park.

findings.quote: Guests are only steps from Madison Avenue's renowned luxury boutiques and fashion houses, and a 5 minute walk from Central Park.

claims.text: The Lowell was established in 1927 and is one of the few remaining family-owned hotels in New York.

findings.quote: Established in 1927, The Lowell, New York, one of the few remaining family owned hotels in the city

claims.text: The hotel is privately owned by the Chartouni family.

findings.quote: It’s currently privately owned by the Chartouni family

claims.text: Rooms and suites are inspired by designer Michael Smith's residential style, and features include original wood-burning fireplaces.

findings.quote: Inspired by designer Michael Smith’s timeless residential style, 47 individually-appointed suites and 27 deluxe rooms are graced with the coveted luxuries of a private New York apartment from original wood-burning fireplaces

claims.text: Many rooms and suites can be connected and feature kitchenettes.

findings.quote: many of which can be connected and feature kitchenettes

claims.text: Majorelle, the restaurant, serves French-Mediterranean cuisine with Moroccan influences.

findings.quote: Majorelle offers French-Mediterranean cuisine with Moroccan influences

claims.text: Jacques Bar serves classic cocktails and small plates.

findings.quote: head to Jacques Bar, where you can enjoy classic cocktails and small plates

claims.text: The Pembroke Room serves breakfast and weekend brunch.

findings.quote: the reimagined Pembroke Room upholds tradition with its beloved breakfast and weekend brunch

claims.text: The Club Room has its own bar and a fireplace.

findings.quote: Next to it is the Club Room, a sophisticated, beautifully decorated space with its own bar (and another fireplace)

claims.text: Through a partnership, guests have access to Dior Spa New York, at the corner of Madison Avenue and 57th Street.

findings.quote: through its partnership with the renowned Dior Spa New York, an exclusive wellness destination located at the corner of Madison Avenue and 57th street

claims.text: The hotel's fireplaces are applewood-burning.

findings.quote: The hotel features rare applewood-burning fireplaces

claims.text: The building was built in the 1920s as a luxury apartment house; Dorothy Parker lived there for a spell, and F. Scott and Zelda Fitzgerald spent time there.

findings.quote: The Lowell was built in the 1920 as a luxury apartment house (Dorothy Parker lived there for a spell after she left the Algonquin; F. Scott and Zelda spent time there as well).

claims.text: The Lily of the Valley Afternoon Tea, served at Majorelle, is a collaboration with Dior Maison.

findings.quote: The Lowell is excited to collaborate with Dior Maison on the Lily of the Valley Afternoon Tea served at Majorelle.

claims.text: The multilingual Golden Keys Concierge team can arrange experiences such as VIP entry to The Armory or a private after-hours tour of The Frick.

findings.quote: The Lowell's multilingual Golden Keys Concierge team are expert guides to the city that never sleeps.
VIP entry to The Armory, tickets to a sold-out show, or a private after-hours tour of The Frick

claims.text: Michael S. Smith, who updated the guest spaces, is the designer behind the White House refresh during Obama's presidency.

findings.quote: All of the guest spaces were updated by Michael S. Smith, the designer behind the White House refresh during Obama’s presidency

claims.text: Wood-burning fireplaces are limited to certain room categories; guests who need one guaranteed should contact the Reservations Team.

findings.quote: A true luxury element, however is limited to certain room categories so we advise in case you need a fireplace guaranteed with your room type and booking, contact our Reservations Team directly!

claims.text: There is no spa at the hotel, but there is a small fitness center; the partner Dior Spa is at Madison Avenue and 57th Street.

findings.quote: There is no spa but there is a very good small fitness center
Dior Spa New York, an exclusive wellness destination located at the corner of Madison Avenue and 57th street

claims.text: Not all bathrooms have a bathtub, so guests should state their preference when booking.

findings.quote: Not all bathrooms offer a bathtub so to ensure your needs are met, contact our Reservations Team at time of booking to let them know your preferences of room type.
